section.title: Cool Down (5 minutes)
Student Activity
section.para: In all the division problems we completed that had a remainder of zero, we say that the divisor was a factor of the dividend.
Whenever a divisor, \(x-c\), divides a polynomial function, \(f(x)\), and results in a remainder of zero, we say \(x-c\) is a factor of \(f(x)\).
This leads us to the Factor Theorem.

list.item: if \(x-c\) is a factor of \(f(x)\), then \(f(c)=0\).
if \(f(c)=0\), then \(x-c\) is a factor of \(f(x)\).

section.para: Use the Factor Theorem to determine whether the binomial is a factor of the given polynomial function. Be prepared to show your reasoning.
